resources.string: Root access
No signs of root found
Signs of root were found on this device
Root lets any app read other apps’ data and switch off protections. Banking and payment apps treat it as a high risk.
Use a device with stock firmware and a locked bootloader, or remove root and restore the original system image.
Hardware key attestation
Keys are backed by secure hardware and the boot chain is verified
The device could not prove a locked, verified boot
A statement signed by the secure hardware is the strongest on-device evidence of a trustworthy system. This app reads it locally; a server still has to verify the certificate chain.
Relock the bootloader and flash the manufacturer’s firmware.
Screen lock
A screen lock is set
No screen lock is set
Without a lock, anyone holding the phone can open apps and read saved data. Keys held in hardware also depend on a lock to stay protected.
Open Settings, Security, Screen lock, and choose a PIN, pattern or password.
Security patch level
The security patch is recent
The security patch is out of date
Old patch levels leave publicly known vulnerabilities open. Attackers reuse them because the exploits are already published.
Install the latest system update. If the maker no longer ships updates, plan to replace the device.
Developer options
Developer options are off
Developer options are on
Developer options expose switches that weaken device protections, such as fake locations and extra logging.
Turn developer options off in Settings, System, Developer options.
USB debugging
USB debugging is off
USB debugging is on
With USB debugging on, a connected computer can read app data and run commands on the phone.
Turn it off in Developer options when you are not developing.
Emulator
Running on a physical device
Running on an emulator
Emulators make it easy to inspect memory, replay traffic and automate abuse, and they lack hardware protections.
Run the app on a physical device.
Biometric lock
Strong biometrics are enrolled
No strong biometric is enrolled
Strong biometrics make it harder to unlock the phone by watching or guessing a PIN. This is advice, not a defect.
Add a fingerprint or face in Settings, Security.
Play Integrity
A Play Integrity token was issued; a server must verify it
The Play Integrity request failed
Play Integrity lets your server learn whether a request comes from a genuine app on a genuine device. The verdict has to be decoded on a server, never inside the app.
Set the cloud project number and verify tokens on your backend. See docs/play-integrity-backend.md.
App signature
The app is signed with the expected certificate
The signing certificate does not match
A different certificate means the app was re-signed, so its code may have been modified.
Install the app only from the official store. If you build it yourself, set EXPECTED_CERT_SHA256 to your release certificate.
Install source
Installed from a trusted store
Not installed from a trusted store
Apps from unknown sources skip store review and are a common route for repackaged malware.
Reinstall from Google Play or another store you trust.
Debuggable build
The build is not debuggable
The build is debuggable
A debuggable app lets anyone attach a debugger and read its memory and files.
Ship release builds only, and check that debuggable is false in the release build type.
Code shrinking
Code is shrunk and obfuscated
Code is not obfuscated
Readable class and method names make reverse engineering much faster. Obfuscation slows it down; it does not stop it.
Turn on minifyEnabled and shrinkResources for release, and keep the mapping file.
Target SDK
The app targets a current Android version
The app targets an old Android version
Apps that target old versions run without newer platform protections.
Raise targetSdk to the latest stable level and handle the behavior changes.
Debugger
No debugger is attached
A debugger is attached
An attached debugger can read and change values while the app runs, including keys and tokens.
Detach the debugger, and do not run release builds under one.
Frida instrumentation
No Frida traces found
Traces of Frida were found
Frida injects code into a running app to bypass checks and read secrets. Detection here is heuristic and can be evaded.
Stop the Frida server and restart the app. Treat the device as untrusted until you know why it was running.
Xposed and LSPosed
No hooking framework found
A hooking framework was found
Hooking frameworks change app behavior at runtime, including security decisions.
Disable the module scope for this app, or remove the framework.
Magisk
No Magisk traces found
Traces of Magisk were found
Magisk is the most common way to root a phone and hide the root from apps.
Uninstall Magisk with its own uninstaller and restore the stock boot image.
Injected code
No foreign code is loaded in this process
Unexpected libraries are loaded in this process
Libraries from temporary folders or other apps usually mean something injected code into this app.
Restart the app and find what loads the library. Remove tools that inject into other apps.
VPN
No VPN is active
A VPN is active
A VPN is not a risk by itself. It matters because it can route your traffic through a third party.
Use only a VPN you trust.
HTTP proxy
No proxy is set
A proxy is set for this network
A proxy can read and change traffic that is not pinned, which is how traffic is usually inspected.
Remove the proxy in the Wi-Fi network settings unless you set it on purpose.
User certificates
No user-installed CA certificates
User-installed CA certificates are present
A CA the user installed can sign certificates for any site, so traffic can be decrypted unless the app pins its servers.
Remove certificates you do not recognise in Settings, Security, Encryption and credentials.
Cleartext traffic
The app blocks unencrypted HTTP
The app allows unencrypted HTTP
Plain HTTP can be read and changed by anyone on the network path.
Set cleartextTrafficPermitted to false in the network security config.
Hardware-backed keystore
Keys can be kept in secure hardware
Keys are kept in software only
Keys in secure hardware cannot be copied off the device, even with root.
Use a device with a TEE or StrongBox, and create keys with setIsStrongBoxBacked where it is available.
App backup
App data is excluded from backups
App data can be backed up
Backed-up data leaves the protection of the device and can be restored elsewhere.
Set allowBackup to false and exclude sensitive files in the backup rules.
Exported components
No unprotected exported components
Some components are exported without protection
An exported component can be started by any app on the phone, which can lead to data leaks or spoofed requests.
Set exported to false, or protect the component with a signature permission.
Accessibility services
No third-party accessibility service is active
A third-party accessibility service is active
Accessibility services can read the screen and tap for you. Malware abuses this to read codes and steal credentials.
Turn off the services you do not use in Settings, Accessibility.
A VPN is active
Strong biometrics are not available
A token was issued; a server must verify it
No certificate is pinned for this build; the fingerprint is shown for reference
